messages:
Priya: Quick sync re: SDK compatibility plan partners asked for. We need a concrete timeline and vendor-facing migration checklist.
Mateo: Agreed. couple constraints: marketplace listings require a 120-day deprecation notice for bundles, and SI partners want a 60-day opt-in support window for managed adapters.
Jenna: Breaking changes summary: 1) auth header unification (we're standardizing on Authorization: Bearer) 2) streaming frame marker changed (clients need to parse 0x7e prefixed frames) 3) response field rename cost_summary -> token_usage. No binary protocol changes.
Raj: On versioning: propose semver-like SDK tags (v1.0, v2.0) + a compatibility header Accept-SDK: v1 which triggers server-side shim. That buys partner time.
Priya: good. vendor asks for test harness they can run in CI against marketplace staging. can devex produce a lightweight conformance suite?
Mateo: devex can. we'll publish a docker image with a small test matrix: languages (js/py), streaming on/off, quantized/no-quant. repo: https://github.com/redwood/partner-conformance
Jenna: legal: also require a telemetry notice and cert that partner adapters don't export PII. marketplace-bot: marketplace policy: include "deprecation_notice" field in listing metadata.
marketplace-bot: Action required: update listing metadata by 1768880000 to avoid auto-unpublish.
Priya: timeline proposal: announce today (partner mailing + marketplace metadata), open canary for partners in 3 weeks, compatibility shim enabled for 120 days, hard cut at 240 days. Partners can request extensions.
Raj: Implementation notes for eng: 1) server shim for Accept-SDK + response warnings 2) admin API toggle per-partner PATCH /orgs/{org}/settings {sdk_shim: true} 3) telemetry flag to mark shimmed requests for rollback metrics.
Mateo: effort estimate: shim + admin flag ~4 dev-days, conformance image 2 dev-days, docs + examples 1 dev-day. QA: 3 days across infra/devex.
Jenna: coordination: hardware partners (Arm/Intel GPUs) need a perf sanity run. If perf regresses for quantized models we'll stagger rollout by cluster tag.
Priya: partner communication draft? Mateo can you and market ops produce a short FAQ and migration snippets? Include sample curl and Node snippet.
Mateo: will do. sample curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept-SDK: v1" https://api.redwood.com/v2/chat/stream
```
Jenna: add rollback playbook to notices. marketplace requires a joint announcement 14 days before hard cut if listing behavior changes.
Priya: ok action items: (1) Eng: shim + admin toggle (Mateo/Raj) (2) Devex: conformance + samples (Mateo) (3) Legal/Marketplace: finalize notice + listing metadata (Jenna) (4) Partnerships: run partner opt-in spreadsheet and exceptions (Priya).
Raj: I'll start a PR for the admin endpoint and the shim router.
Mateo: I'll spin up the conformance image skeleton and draft the FAQ.
Priya: Thanks. We'll reconvene after canary metrics. :rocket:
